violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Shelving underneath the prep area needs to be cleaned. The cabinet doors and fronts need to be cleaned under the pop dispensers.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. The hood vents over the fryers are covered in dust and need to be cleaned.

Handling of clean equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not handled in a manner to prevent contamination of food-contact surface. Sanitized and drying utensils and equipment were being drained on cloth towels. Need to be stored/drained on a clean non-absorbent surface.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Single use foam cups next to the pop dispensing machines were sitting on the bare counter and had over-splash and residue from liquids being dispensed.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. Employees sweatshirts was being stored in a box of crackers underneath the prep table.

Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insect electrocution or trapping device was installed in an inappropriate location. Several fly strips throughout the facility were hung over food prep areas and hot food holding containers.

General food protection. — --Potentially hazardous food was not stored at proper temperature of 41 degrees. Containers of boba pearls were open and not refrigerated after as instructed on the package.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Boxes of food being stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Cardboard being used on the freezer racking to hold food items is not a non-absorbent cleanable surface.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Boxes of single use items being stored on the floor in the dry storage area.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors in the walk-in cooler and freezer need to be cleaned more thoroughly.
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (2 pts deducted)
